definition: Compounds that disrupt the MDM2-p53 interaction.
inclusion_rule: Direct MDM2 antagonist with documented p53-reactivating pharmacology.
exclusion_rule: Downstream p53 modulators without direct MDM2 antagonism.
polarity_model: positive Chem score denotes concordance with compound-induced transcription
v3_rule_note: MDM2/MDM4 as the only primary targets; E3-ligase inhibitors are not separable from PPI antagonists by target alone

definition: Compounds whose primary pharmacology directly inhibits EGFR/ERBB-family kinases.
inclusion_rule: Direct EGFR, dual ERBB, or pan-ERBB kinase inhibitor.
exclusion_rule: Downstream MEK inhibitors and broad multikinase agents without core ERBB selectivity.
polarity_model: positive Chem score denotes concordance with compound-induced transcription
v3_rule_note: EGFR/ERBB only; multikinase agents excluded by the subset rule

definition: Compounds that directly inhibit MEK1 and/or MEK2.
exclusion_rule: Upstream EGFR/ERBB or RAF inhibition.
polarity_model: positive Chem score denotes concordance with compound-induced transcription

definition: Selective or primary RAF inhibitors used to suppress oncogenic RAF signaling.
inclusion_rule: Direct RAF inhibitor with RAF as the primary intended target.
exclusion_rule: RAF-containing multikinase drugs, downstream MEK inhibitors, and BCR::ABL1 inhibitors.
polarity_model: positive Chem score denotes concordance with compound-induced transcription

definition: Rapamycin and analogues that inhibit mTORC1 through FKBP12.
exclusion_rule: Catalytic mTOR, PI3K, or dual PI3K-mTOR inhibitors.
polarity_model: positive Chem score denotes concordance with compound-induced transcription
v3_rule_note: rapamycin analogues: MTOR among the curated or bioactivity genes, and FKBP1A or the -olimus INN stem / rapamycin named; calcineurin-directed FKBP12 ligands (tacrolimus, pimecrolimus) excluded by the calcineurin genes or a calcineurin mechanism text; genes judged on all curated and bioactivity sources

definition: ATP-competitive inhibitors of mTOR kinase complexes.
exclusion_rule: Allosteric rapalogs and PI3K-only inhibitors.
polarity_model: positive Chem score denotes concordance with compound-induced transcription
v3_rule_note: ATP-competitive mTOR inhibitors

definition: Compounds that directly inhibit both PI3K and mTOR catalytic activity.
inclusion_rule: Documented dual PI3K and mTOR pharmacology.
exclusion_rule: PI3K-only, mTOR-only, or allosteric rapalog pharmacology.
polarity_model: positive Chem score denotes concordance with compound-induced transcription
v3_rule_note: requires MTOR and a class I PI3K catalytic subunit

definition: Compounds whose primary pharmacology inhibits class I PI3K.
exclusion_rule: Dual PI3K-mTOR and mTOR-only inhibition.
polarity_model: positive Chem score denotes concordance with compound-induced transcription

definition: Compounds that directly inhibit HSP90 chaperone function.
exclusion_rule: General proteostasis perturbagens without HSP90 pharmacology.

definition: Compounds targeting constitutive proteasome catalytic activity, including PSMB5-directed agents.
inclusion_rule: Clinically established or selective constitutive proteasome inhibitor.
exclusion_rule: Immunoproteasome-selective inhibitors and broad protease tools.
polarity_model: positive Chem score denotes concordance with compound-induced transcription
v3_rule_note: any constitutive catalytic subunit or the 26S proteasome complex

definition: Compounds selective for immunoproteasome PSMB8/LMP7.

polarity_model: positive Chem score denotes concordance with compound-induced transcription

definition: Compounds directly inhibiting one or more Aurora kinases.
exclusion_rule: Microtubule-directed agents without Aurora inhibition.
polarity_model: positive Chem score denotes concordance with compound-induced transcription
v3_rule_note: Aurora kinases as the only primary targets

definition: Compounds that bind tubulin and stabilize microtubules.
exclusion_rule: Aurora inhibitors and microtubule destabilizers.
polarity_model: positive Chem score denotes concordance with compound-induced transcription
v3_rule_note: v2 members retained; new tubulin-binding compounds are assigned to MICROTUBULE_TARGETING because the databases do not separate stabilisers from destabilisers

definition: Compounds whose primary pharmacology is binding to tubulin, stabilising or destabilising microtubules.

exclusion_rule: Compounds acting on mitotic kinases or motor proteins rather than tubulin.
polarity_model: positive Chem score denotes concordance with compound-induced transcription
v3_rule_note: covers v2 MICROTUBULE_STABILIZER and MICROTUBULE_DESTABILIZER: ChEMBL and LINCS mostly record taxanes and vinca alkaloids alike as tubulin inhibitors, so the stabiliser / destabiliser split is left to review
